key: Night Shift/Night Shift.adf:Night Shift/IML:0:12CF8
name: advance_stream_and_store_value
description: Copies a pointer and a command word from the source record into the state block and returns early when the command word is zero. Otherwise it stores the command fields, advances a byte pointer through the stream, and writes a value to the output block that is reduced by an offset kept in the state, clamped at zero.

key: Night Shift/Night Shift.adf:Night Shift/IML:0:12D22
name: read_indirect_command_and_advance
description: Fetches the next command record either directly or through a stored pointer table, then copies its word count and command fields into the state. It then runs the same stream-advance and clamped output logic as the neighbouring routines.

key: Night Shift/Night Shift.adf:Night Shift/IML:0:12D3A
name: load_pointer_and_advance_stream
description: Copies a long word from the source record into the state block and stores the address just past it as the current stream position. It then sets the command fields and writes the clamped output value like the other stream routines.

key: Night Shift/Night Shift.adf:Night Shift/IML:0:12D48
name: copy_header_and_advance_stream
description: Copies two long words from the source record into the state block, then fills the command fields from the following word. It then runs the shared stream-advance and clamped output logic.

key: Night Shift/Night Shift.adf:Night Shift/IML:0:12D54
name: copy_triple_header_and_advance
description: Sets a state flag to one, copies three long words from the source record into the state block, and then runs the common command-field setup and clamped output logic.

key: Night Shift/Night Shift.adf:Night Shift/IML:0:12D6A
name: clear_counter_and_advance_stream
description: Clears a state word, takes the command word and its count from the source record, and runs the shared stream-advance and clamped output logic.

key: Night Shift/Night Shift.adf:Night Shift/IML:0:12D72
name: clear_flag_and_advance_stream
description: Clears the state flag at offset 8, then runs the shared command setup and clamped output logic taken from the source record.

key: Night Shift/Night Shift.adf:Night Shift/IML:0:12D7A
name: reset_state_by_record_type
description: Sets a global flag to one and clears a word in the record at A2. It then zeroes one of four per-type global variables chosen by the record type at A0: type 6, type 5, type 7, or any other type each have their own.

key: Night Shift/Night Shift.adf:Night Shift/IML:0:12D8C
name: store_d5_and_clear_word
description: Sets a global flag to one, copies the input word from register D5 into a second global, and zeroes the word at offset 8 of the record at A2. It then clears one of the per-type state variables. Nothing in this pseudo-code writes to audio or DMA hardware.

key: Night Shift/Night Shift.adf:Night Shift/IML:0:12DAC
name: store_d5_clear_state_word
description: Sets a global flag to one, copies the input word from register D5 into a second global, and zeroes the word at offset 8 of the record at A2. It then clears a different per-type state variable from the one used by the neighbouring routine. Nothing in this pseudo-code writes to audio or DMA hardware.

key: Night Shift/Night Shift.adf:Night Shift/IML:0:12DCC
name: store_d5_clear_flag_word
description: Sets a global flag to one, copies the input word from register D5 into a second global, and zeroes the word at offset 8 of the record at A2. It then clears one of the per-type state variables. Nothing in this pseudo-code writes to audio or DMA hardware.

key: Night Shift/Night Shift.adf:Night Shift/IML:0:12DEC
name: store_d5_clear_type_word
description: Sets a global flag to one, copies the input word from register D5 into a second global, and zeroes the word at offset 8 of the record at A2. It then clears a different per-type state variable. Nothing in this pseudo-code writes to audio or DMA hardware.

key: Night Shift/Night Shift.adf:Night Shift/IML:0:12E0C
name: set_flag_and_advance_stream
description: Sets a state flag to one, then reads a command word from the source record and runs the shared stream-advance and clamped output logic.

key: Night Shift/Night Shift.adf:Night Shift/IML:0:13E4C
name: reset_globals_and_call_setup
description: When one global variable is zero, it clears four state globals, sets a fifth to ten, and calls the shared routine that updates state. It does nothing otherwise.

key: Night Shift/Night Shift.adf:Night Shift/IML:0:13E8A
name: call_setup_routine_three_times
description: When a global variable is zero, it calls the same shared routine three times in a row and returns. Otherwise it does nothing.

key: Night Shift/Night Shift.adf:Night Shift/IML:0:13EC2
name: update_state_and_countdown
description: Updates a set of state values while an enable global is non-zero and a gate global is zero. It switches two state values between branches using a counter threshold and record flags, calls the shared routine on each change, and counts a countdown down that reloads when it reaches zero.

key: Night Shift/Night Shift.adf:Night Shift/IML:0:140D4
name: copy_zero_terminated_string
description: Copies bytes from the source string into the destination buffer one at a time, including the terminating zero byte, and returns the original destination pointer.

key: Night Shift/Night Shift.adf:Night Shift/IML:0:140E4
name: compute_string_length
description: Walks forward through a zero-terminated byte string until the terminator and returns the number of bytes before it. It does not change memory.

key: Night Shift/Night Shift.adf:Night Shift/IML:0:140F6
name: compare_two_byte_strings
description: Compares two byte strings one byte at a time, stopping at the first difference or when the first string ends, and returns a negative or positive value according to which byte is smaller. The comparison is limited to about 32 thousand bytes and returns zero when the strings match.

key: Night Shift/Night Shift.adf:Night Shift/IML:0:14126
name: pass_argument_to_callee
description: Passes its single argument unchanged to another routine and returns. The callee is not identified in this pseudo-code, so the wrapper adds no behaviour of its own.

key: Night Shift/Night Shift.adf:Night Shift/IML:0:1413E
name: open_file_into_free_slot
description: Searches a table for an unused entry, then opens the named file through the DOS wrapper routines, falling back to a second open mode when the first attempt fails. It records the handle and flags in the entry and returns the entry index, or minus one with an error code stored when no entry or handle is available.

key: Night Shift/Night Shift.adf:Night Shift/IML:0:142A6
name: read_with_dos_error_check
description: Reads data through the DOS read wrapper and queries the DOS error code when the read fails. The decompiled body was unavailable, so only these calls are recovered and the exact behaviour beyond them is not shown.

key: Night Shift/Night Shift.adf:Night Shift/IML:0:14338
name: open_dos_library_or_alert
description: Opens the DOS library by name through the exec library vector and raises a system alert if the open fails. When it succeeds it calls a follow-up routine, and a status bit in the system base selects a supervisor call beforehand.

key: Night Shift/Night Shift.adf:Night Shift/IML:0:143B6
name: empty_return_stub
description: Does nothing and returns immediately, with no effect on any state. It is a one-instruction stub that callers reach without side effects.

key: Night Shift/Night Shift.adf:Night Shift/IML:0:143BE
name: allocate_manx_object
description: Allocates a cleared memory block for an object sized from a table count and returns early if the allocation fails. On success it writes the ASCII tag MANX, sets the initial flags and pointers, and links the object to a parent entry, with the link path depending on a data flag in the parent.

key: Night Shift/Night Shift.adf:Night Shift/IML:0:14540
name: split_command_line_into_args
description: Copies the command text into a buffer, then splits it into words separated by spaces, tabs or line breaks, keeping double-quoted sections together. It allocates a pointer array holding the start of each word, ends the list with a zero entry, and sets the word count to zero if the allocation fails.

key: Night Shift/Night Shift.adf:Night Shift/IML:0:14734
name: append_string_bounded
description: Appends the source string to the end of the destination string, copying at most about 32 thousand bytes. If the copy stops early it writes a terminator after the last byte copied, and it returns the destination pointer.

key: Night Shift/Night Shift.adf:Night Shift/IML:0:1473A
name: append_string_with_count
description: Appends the source string to the end of the destination string, copying no more than the count passed in the third argument. If the count runs out before the source ends, it writes a terminator after the last byte copied, and it returns the destination pointer.

key: Night Shift/Night Shift.adf:Night Shift/IML:0:1475E
name: copy_string_pad_zeros
description: Copies bytes from the source string into the destination, stopping at the terminator or when the count in the third argument is used up. Any remaining positions up to that count are filled with zero bytes.

key: Night Shift/Night Shift.adf:Night Shift/IML:0:14780
name: multiply_32_bit_values
description: Multiplies two 32-bit values by computing the low 32 bits of the product from partial products of their 16-bit halves. That value is returned in the high 32-bit half, with the second operand in the low half.

key: Night Shift/Night Shift.adf:Night Shift/IML:0:147A4
name: open_icon_and_window_handles
description: Opens a handle by the icon.library name and then uses the WINDOW text to open a second handle through the library vector. On success it stores the resulting pointers in the caller's state block, and it releases the handles it opened before returning.

key: Night Shift/Night Shift.adf:Night Shift/IML:0:1486C
name: sign_correct_unsigned_result
description: Notes whether the two operands have opposite signs, runs the unsigned operation through a shared helper, and negates that result when the signs differ. The result goes in the high 32-bit half with the second operand in the low half.

key: Night Shift/Night Shift.adf:Night Shift/IML:0:1486E
name: apply_sign_to_unsigned_result
description: Works out the sign of the result from the two inputs, runs a shared helper, and negates its output when needed. The result is returned in the high 32-bit half with the second input in the low half.

key: Night Shift/Night Shift.adf:Night Shift/IML:0:14896
name: negate_result_if_first_negative
description: Calls a helper, then negates its second output when the first input is negative. The value is returned in the high 32-bit half with the original low word.

key: Night Shift/Night Shift.adf:Night Shift/IML:0:148BC
name: call_helper_and_return
description: Calls another routine with no arguments and returns to its caller without any other work. The callee is not identified in this pseudo-code.

key: Night Shift/Night Shift.adf:Night Shift/IML:0:148C6
name: divide_32_bit_values
description: Divides the first 32-bit value by the second. It uses a 16-step shift-and-subtract loop when the divisor is larger than 16 bits, and 16-bit division otherwise, returning the quotient in the high 32-bit half and the remainder in the low half.

key: Night Shift/Night Shift.adf:Night Shift/IML:0:14916
name: write_with_dos_error_check
description: Calls the DOS write wrapper and the DOS error query wrapper. The decompiled body was unavailable, so only these calls are recovered and the exact behaviour beyond them is not shown.

key: Night Shift/Night Shift.adf:Night Shift/IML:0:149A4
name: check_library_bit_result
description: Calls a library function through the library vector with a flag argument and tests bit twelve of the returned value. When that bit is set it returns the value if a global flag is zero, or calls a follow-up routine and returns zero otherwise. When the bit is clear it returns zero.

key: Night Shift/Night Shift.adf:Night Shift/IML:0:149DA
name: process_global_data_block
description: Passes the address of a global variable with a size of four to one routine, passes its result to a second routine, and then makes a third call. The Output and Write wrappers are among the callees, and the callees are not identified beyond that in this pseudo-code.

key: Night Shift/Night Shift.adf:Night Shift/IML:0:14A0A
name: call_optional_hook_then_helper
description: Calls a global function pointer if it is set, then calls another routine. The second callee is not identified in this pseudo-code.

key: Night Shift/Night Shift.adf:Night Shift/IML:0:14A2E
name: release_state_buffers_on_exit
description: Calls a helper for each entry of a table, runs an optional stored hook, and releases several buffers whose pointers are set. It also issues a supervisor call when a status bit in the exec base is set, and then releases a last buffer.

key: Night Shift/Night Shift.adf:Night Shift/IML:0:14B96
name: close_table_file_entry
description: Looks up a file-table entry by index and returns minus one with an error code when the index is out of range or the entry is empty. Otherwise it closes the entry's handle unless the top bit of its flag byte is set, clears the entry, and returns zero.

key: Night Shift/Night Shift.adf:Night Shift/IML:0:14C72
name: unlock_dos_file_lock
description: Calls the UnLock function through the DOS library base stored in a global variable, passing the caller's arguments unchanged, and returns. The jump target could not be recovered in the decompiled code, but the library offset matches UnLock.

key: Night Shift/Night Shift.adf:Night Shift/IML:0:14CBE
name: call_exec_library_function
description: Calls a function through a library vector in the exec base stored in a global variable, with no arguments, and returns. The specific function is not identified in this pseudo-code.

key: Night Shift/Night Shift.adf:Night Shift/IML:0:14CD2
name: allocate_and_fill_request_block
description: Obtains a slot number and allocates a cleared thirty-four byte block, then fills its fields with the parameters, a type code of four, and the slot number. It stores the result of a further call and passes the block to one of two routines depending on whether the first parameter is zero. It returns the block, or zero if a step fails.

key: Night Shift/Night Shift.adf:Night Shift/IML:0:14D6A
name: release_request_block_chain
description: Calls itself on the same block while its link field is non-zero, then marks the block's type and slot fields as unused. It calls a routine with the slot number and then frees the thirty-four byte block passed in.

key: Night Shift/Night Shift.adf:Night Shift/IML:0:14DD6
name: call_helper_with_fixed_argument
description: Passes its one argument and the fixed value forty-eight to another routine and returns. The callee is not identified in this pseudo-code.

key: Night Shift/Night Shift.adf:Night Shift/IML:0:14DF6
name: forward_argument_to_helper
description: Forwards its single argument unchanged to another routine and returns. The callee is not identified in this pseudo-code.

key: Night Shift/Night Shift.adf:Night Shift/IML:0:14E12
name: allocate_block_with_type_five
description: Returns zero when the first argument is zero. Otherwise it allocates a block of the size given in the second argument and stores type code five, the low word of that size, and the first argument in the block. It returns the block, or zero if the allocation fails.

key: Night Shift/Night Shift.adf:Night Shift/IML:0:14E5C
name: mark_block_unused_and_release
description: Returns zero when given no block. Otherwise it marks the block's type and two slot fields as unused, passes the block and its stored size word to the release routine, and returns that result.

key: Night Shift/Night Shift.adf:Night Shift/IML:0:14E74
name: mark_block_fields_unused
description: Marks a block's type byte and two slot fields as unused, then calls a routine. The callee is not identified in this pseudo-code.

key: Night Shift/Night Shift.adf:Night Shift/IML:0:14E9E
name: call_exec_vector_198
description: Calls a function through the exec base at a library offset of negative 198, with no arguments, and returns. The specific function is not identified in this pseudo-code.

key: Night Shift/Night Shift.adf:Night Shift/IML:0:14EE0
name: call_exec_vector_294
description: Calls a function through the exec base at a library offset of negative 294, with no arguments, and returns. The specific function is not identified in this pseudo-code.

key: Night Shift/Night Shift.adf:Night Shift/IML:0:14EF4
name: call_exec_vector_132

key: Night Shift/Night Shift.adf:Night Shift/IML:0:14F04
name: call_exec_vector_210
description: Calls a function through the exec base at a library offset of negative 210, with no arguments, and returns. The specific function is not identified in this pseudo-code.

name: init_empty_list_header
description: Initializes a list header in the block at the given address: the first long points four bytes past the header, the next long is cleared, and the third long points back to the header. This leaves the list empty.

key: Night Shift/Night Shift.adf:Night Shift/IML:0:14F62
name: call_exec_vector_552
description: Calls a function through the exec base at a library offset of negative 552, with no arguments, and returns. The specific function is not identified in this pseudo-code.

key: Night Shift/Night Shift.adf:Night Shift/IML:0:15024
name: call_library_vector_78
description: Calls a function at library offset negative 78 through a library base stored in a global variable, with no arguments, and returns. The library's identity is not established in this pseudo-code.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:c/CD:0:0136
name: copy_sixteen_longs_then_call
description: If the destination pointer passed on the stack is set, copies sixteen long words from a fixed offset in the data area into it. It then calls the routine whose address is held in the A5 register and returns.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:0000
name: program_entry_open_library
description: The program entry point: it saves the exec base and a value passed in registers, runs a supervisor call when a status bit is set, and opens a library through the exec open-library vector. If the open fails it raises a system alert, and otherwise it calls the startup routine.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:000E
name: call_three_helper_routines
description: Calls three other routines. The decompiled body was unavailable, so only these calls are recovered and the purpose of the routine is not shown.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:0064
name: copy_global_word
description: Copies one global word variable into another global word variable and returns. Nothing else happens in the routine.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:0076
name: advance_pseudorandom_seed
description: Updates a global seed word with a multiply-and-add step, in the style of a linear congruential generator. It returns the high part of the product together with the new seed shifted right by one bit.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:0094
name: initialize_copper_display_lists
description: Allocates graphics buffers through graphics library calls and builds a copper list in them, writing list entries spaced forty bytes apart, then enables DMA channels. It also refers to a disk prompt that asks the user to remove write protection and press a key.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:02FE
name: open_system_libraries
description: Opens two libraries by name and calls an error routine when either open returns nothing. The routine references exec.library and intuition.library. When a flag in the second library's data is set it calls a routine with a stored value, and it then passes that library to another routine before returning.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:03D2
name: call_two_routines
description: Calls two other routines one after the other and returns. The callees are not identified in this pseudo-code.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:03EA
name: store_global_parameters
description: Stores the first long argument into one global variable and the low word of the second argument into the adjacent global word.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:0402
name: decompress_run_length_block
description: Reads a six-byte header, then either copies the block as it is or decodes a run-length packed block into memory. In the packed mode a control byte with the top bit set repeats the next byte, and one with the top bit clear copies the following literal bytes. The status output is one when the first call fails, two on read errors, and three for an unsupported header mode.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:0668
name: call_two_helpers_unrecovered
description: Calls two other routines. The decompiled body was unavailable, so only these calls are recovered and the purpose of the routine is not shown.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:073A
name: return_without_action
description: Immediately returns to the caller and performs no action. The listed call does not appear in the decompiled code.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:073E
name: run_disk_op_report_error
description: Runs a disk operation through the shared helper with a status output, then writes the fixed DMA control value that enables channels. If the status is nonzero it calls the error routine with the disk error text.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:078E
name: adjust_backpiece_table_entries
description: Reads a count and reports a table overflow when it exceeds a fixed limit. It then adds a stored offset to each entry's first long, terminates the table with a fixed value, and when its argument is set it calls a helper that loads a backdrop resource. The backdrop file names referenced include back_dat, back_stc and fi_bike.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:08C8
name: load_named_data_into_table
description: Loads named data files into a table at offsets derived from a base value, using one of two sequences depending on a mode flag. The referenced names include hsc_cfg.iml and F.FIXIT, and the first branch also writes a fixed DMA control value.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:09DC
name: toggle_flag_and_load_records
description: Inverts a flag byte in the state block at a fixed offset, then runs the record-loading sequence. The loading sequence is described in the neighbouring routine.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:09E4
name: load_records_by_mode
description: Runs one of two loading sequences depending on a mode global. In the first mode it sets up two parameter blocks, requests a named resource, and on success loads two blocks of fixed size; in the second mode it loads several blocks at offsets from a base value. The first mode also writes a fixed control word.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:09EC
name: load_records_from_entry
description: A fragment entry into the same mode-dependent record-loading code as the neighbouring routine. It performs the same loading sequence.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:09F0
name: load_hsc_config_records
description: Runs one of two loading sequences depending on a mode global, using the hsc_cfg.iml text as the named resource in the first mode. The first mode writes a fixed control word that enables DMA channels, and the second loads several blocks at offsets from a base value.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:0B0E
name: store_constants_into_table_entry
description: Writes a series of constant values to a global table entry chosen by the argument times ten. Every write goes to the same entry, so the last constant, one, is what remains.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:0BDE
name: run_disk_read_report_error
description: Runs a disk read through the shared helper with a status output, then writes the fixed DMA control value that enables channels. If the status is nonzero it calls the error routine with the disk error text.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:0C2C
name: swap_two_bytes
description: Exchanges the byte at the given address with the byte that follows it.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:0C52
name: reverse_four_bytes_in_place
description: Reverses the four bytes of the long word at the given address by swapping the first and last bytes and the middle two bytes.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:0C96
name: fill_memory_with_byte
description: Writes the byte taken from the third argument into a block of memory, moving forward one byte at a time until the count given in the second argument reaches zero.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:0CB0
name: move_memory_block
description: Copies a block of bytes from the source to the destination. It copies forward when the destination lies below the source and backwards when it lies at or above it, so overlapping regions are preserved.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:0CDA
name: enable_dma_and_copper
description: Stores a copper-related value and writes a DMA control value with the set bit that enables channels. It then calls a sequence of graphics library routines, and when a mode flag is set it runs two extra routines first.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:0D48
name: allocate_memory_or_report
description: Calls the memory allocation routine with two arguments and returns its result. When the allocation returns zero it calls the error routine that reports that no more memory can be allocated.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:0D9E
name: call_three_subroutines
description: Calls another routine with no arguments, then calls a second routine with the input parameter and the value one, and finally calls the first routine again. The callees are not identified in this pseudo-code.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:0DC6
name: pass_stack_buffer_to_helpers
description: Creates a sixty-byte buffer on the stack and passes it with the first argument to a helper, then with the second argument, and finally alone. The helper is not identified in this pseudo-code.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:0DF6
name: clear_word_table
description: Sets each of the sixty-four word entries of a global table to zero.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:0E1C
name: read_joystick_port_state
description: Increments a poll counter, then combines a table of key states with the joystick port data to return a bitmask. Bits for the two direction pairs are decoded from the port's data register, and the fire bit is tested from the button status register.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:0EA2
name: increment_read_and_clear_flag
description: Increments a global counter, calls a routine, then reads and clears a second global flag and calls the routine again. It returns the value that was read.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:0ED0
name: store_argument_byte_global
description: Stores the byte at offset one of the argument into a global variable and returns.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:0EE0
name: increment_save_and_set_flag
description: Increments a global counter and calls a routine. It then saves a global flag, sets it to the fixed value one hundred twenty-seven, calls the routine again, and returns the saved flag.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:0F10
name: store_argument_word_global
description: Stores the low 16 bits of the argument into a global word variable and returns.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:0F20
name: wait_for_counter_then_reset
description: Increments a global counter and calls a routine. It then sets a second global to one less than a limit when it is at or below that limit, busy-waits until that global reaches the limit, and resets it to zero.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:0F64
name: call_helper_with_global_value
description: Passes the value of a global variable to another routine and returns. The callee is not identified in this pseudo-code.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:0F88
name: call_helper_with_other_global
description: Passes the value of a different global variable to another routine and returns. The callee is not identified in this pseudo-code.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:0FAC
name: update_coordinate_table
description: Swaps two global values and sets a global step to forty. It then writes four pairs of 16-bit coordinates into a global table, spaced forty apart from the swapped value plus four. Two routines are called before the table update and three after it.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:1076
name: wait_and_configure_blitter
description: Waits until the blitter is idle, then sets its masks, modulo registers and control words and loads source and destination pointers from global values offset by fixed amounts. It then starts a blit of a fixed size.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:10D6
name: wait_and_setup_blitter_swapped
description: Performs the same blitter setup as its neighbouring routine, but the source and destination pointers take the other global values, so the two offsets are exchanged.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:1136
name: save_and_set_interrupt_enable
description: Saves a global value into two places, then writes a control value with the enable bit set to the interrupt enable register.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:1164
name: poll_interrupt_request_state
description: Reads the interrupt request and enable registers and the vertical position register, then calls one routine. The decompiled body was unavailable, so the exact behaviour beyond these register references is not recovered.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:11C8
name: restore_saved_global
description: Restores a global variable from the saved copy kept in a second global.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:11DA
name: call_then_spin_forever
description: Calls a routine and then loops forever without returning, so control never passes back to the caller.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:1272
name: stub_bare_return_routine
description: The decompiled body is a bare return, although the instruction count is forty. The remaining code is not represented in this pseudo-code, so it is likely unanalysed or dead.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:12E0
name: copy_conditional_word_array
description: Selects a source address from bit flags in the input register, then copies thirty-two words from it in reverse order, reading at four-byte steps. The destination is addressed from a fixed base.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:1308
name: return_low_byte_from_d0
description: Returns the low byte of register D0 and nothing else. Its address is taken rather than called directly.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:134C
name: return_low_byte_second_entry
description: Returns the low byte of register D0 like its neighbouring routine. Its address is taken rather than called directly.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:1398
name: call_helper_with_one
description: Calls another routine with the constant one as its argument and returns. The callee is not identified in this pseudo-code.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:13AE
name: call_helper_with_zero
description: Calls another routine with a zero argument and returns. The callee is not identified in this pseudo-code.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:13C2
name: store_scaled_word_in_table
description: Computes a table index from a global variable minus three, then stores the argument's low word multiplied by 256 plus a fixed constant into that table entry.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:13EC
name: loop_call_helper_with_global
description: Calls one routine, then calls another routine with a global word value once for each count in the argument, and calls the first routine again at the end. The routines are not identified in this pseudo-code.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:1428
name: scan_and_patch_table
description: Clears eight index globals, then scans a word table up to a sentinel and records the positions of entries holding three marker values in those globals. It then writes a fixed pattern of two words into eight entries at the end of the table.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:157A
name: compute_lcg_sequence
description: Advances a 16-bit linear congruential value from a fixed seed a number of times set by a global counter. It returns the quotient of the result by 625 in the high word and, in the low word, whether the remainder equals a global value.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:15B0
name: delay_and_set_ciab_port
description: Runs three short busy-wait loops and writes a CIA-B port register so that bits three to seven are set while its low three bits are kept.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:15DC
name: confirm_quit_prompt
description: Shows the quit prompt when certain input-state bytes are set and two table entries hold a sentinel value. It then reads keypresses until the answer is N, and a Y answer runs a further routine before returning a result code.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:16D2
name: delay_and_read_flag_bit
description: Writes a CIA-B register, runs a long busy-wait loop, clears some bits of a CIA-A register, and returns whether bit three of a global is clear.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:171A
name: load_chained_global_values
description: Calls a routine with zero arguments to fetch a value and stores it in a global, then calls the same routine with that value and stores the second result in another global. The callee is not identified in this pseudo-code.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:1748
name: read_trackdisk_block_into_buffer
description: Passes the trackdisk device name and a request block to a library routine, then sets up a request with command code two for a one-kilobyte transfer into the buffer argument and sends it. It then sends a request with command code nine and zero length, and sends the block request once more.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:17EA
name: write_trackdisk_block_from_buffer
description: Passes the trackdisk device name and a request block to a library routine, then sets up a request with command code three for a one-kilobyte transfer from the buffer argument and sends it. It then sends a request with command code four, then one with command code nine and zero length.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:18A6
name: compute_data_checksum
description: Computes an additive sum and an exclusive-or checksum over 250 bytes from the buffer, seeded with fixed values. When the second argument is zero it compares both results with the two bytes after the data and returns zero on a match and one otherwise. Otherwise it stores both checksums there and returns minus one.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:18DC
name: compute_word_sum_complement
description: Clears the second long of a block, sums 256 32-bit values from its start with end-around carry, and stores the bitwise complement of that sum in the second long.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:1902
name: reset_then_jump_low_vector
description: Calls a reset routine, then calls through the fixed low memory address two, and returns.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:1912
name: open_keyboard_device
description: Creates a message port and a forty-eight byte request block, then opens keyboard.device with that request block through the library routine. The handles are stored in globals for later input operations.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:196C
name: send_global_buffer_request
description: Sets the request's command field to ten and its length to thirteen, points the data field at a global buffer, sends the request, and then calls a second routine. The command codes are those set in the request block.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:19AE
name: decode_key_state_buffer
description: Compares each keyboard matrix byte with its saved copy and stores the new byte, recording the position of the first bit that went from set to clear. It then expands every byte into eight flag entries in a table. The key labels referenced are the number row of the keyboard.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:1A46
name: retry_title_graphics_load
description: Runs a check loop of up to 220 tries that issues calls and reports the outcome. It returns one on success, zero when the tries are used up, or a stored status when a call reports an error. It refers to the imltitle and qmark graphics files.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:1B3E
name: call_helper_for_range_pair
description: Calls another routine four times: once with the first argument and one, once with the sum of the two arguments minus one and one, and twice with the pair of arguments. The callee is not identified in this pseudo-code.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:1BCE
name: insert_sorted_table_entry
description: Searches a table of ten twenty-byte records from the bottom up for an insertion position. When it finds one it moves the records below down and writes a new record there, returning one. Otherwise it returns zero.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:1D42
name: process_input_selection_loop
description: Builds a list of up to eight items from a parameter table, then polls input in a loop. Up and down move the highlighted item with wraparound, and the list is redrawn on each pass. It returns the chosen index, or minus one when no input arrives within fifteen hundred polls.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:2086
name: run_options_menu_loop
description: Draws the options screen and loops over its menu. Option one toggles the player count between one and two, options two and three call a routine, and option four ends the menu with a success result. Cancel or an error returns zero.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:222E
name: display_main_menu
description: Draws the main menu with its labels for load, save, reset and the player entries, then loops over the selections. One selection toggles a per-player flag and another calls a routine through a function address. The loop ends when the selection is zero or negative.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:2892
name: initialize_state_table
description: Clears a 128-byte buffer and marks the entries named by the first seven bytes of the argument as one. It then passes each of 77 entries from a global table to a routine, with a marker value before and after the sequence.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:295E
name: dispatch_table_entries
description: Reads a byte from a global table at an index times six, then calls a series of routines with offsets derived from that byte. Extra calls run only for the case value ten, and the final call passes the byte shifted into the high position.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:2C44
name: run_name_entry_grid
description: Loads production graphics and runs a letter grid for entering a name, appending each chosen letter to a name buffer. Two special grid entries end the entry or act differently. The bundle truncates this routine, so the graphics setup beyond the visible part and any cheat-mode branch are not recovered.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:38F4
name: run_credits_sequence
description: Draws the credits over several passes, scrolling its text lines at fixed offsets and checking for input on each pass. It returns a stored code or one when an input check fires, and zero when the sequence runs out.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:4306
name: draw_production_records_table
description: Draws the production records table with a header row for name, wages and level, then writes ten rows. Each row takes its four fields from a twenty-byte record and is labelled with its row number.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:443C
name: copy_word_then_call_helper
description: Copies a word from an address offset by a register into the word before its base address, then calls one routine and then another with the two word arguments. The callees are not identified in this pseudo-code.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:4440
name: call_helper_then_pass_words
description: Calls one routine with no arguments, then calls a second routine with the low words of its two arguments.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:4488
name: call_routine_and_return
description: Calls one routine with no arguments and returns to the caller. The callee is not identified in this pseudo-code.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:449A
name: call_four_helpers_in_order
description: Calls four routines in sequence: the first and last with no arguments, and the middle two with the argument zero. The callees are not identified in this pseudo-code.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:44D6
name: call_one_helper_routine
description: Calls one routine with no arguments and returns. The callee is not identified in this pseudo-code.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:44E8
name: display_intro_screen
description: Loads the intro graphics named in its text, including the presents, logo, status bar and character portrait files. It sets up the display, draws the opening screen, and then calls routines to finish the sequence.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:4702
name: display_title_screen
description: Loads the title graphic and draws its text labels. When its flag argument is zero it runs one extra routine first, and when the flag is set it runs another after the title setup.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:47DE
name: check_secret_key_sequence
description: Compares key codes against a stored sequence, advancing a position as each code matches. When the whole sequence has been entered it draws a block of fourteen credit lines. One key code stores a result and returns one, another toggles a flag, and a mismatch resets the position.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:4A52
name: process_input_flags
description: Calls helper routines selected by the low three bits of its flags argument. When the low two bits are clear it waits in a loop until a helper returns a nonzero value. It reads several global state values and passes them to a final routine.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:4B7A
name: find_flagged_table_entry
description: Searches a table of ten-byte entries, up to the count held in a global, for the first entry whose status routine result has bit four set. If none is found it checks one fixed global entry and returns whether bit four is set.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:4BD6
name: run_character_dialogue_stages
description: Draws a sequence of character stages with their graphics and text, naming Cliff Lemming, Frank Foreman, Jodee Lemming and Larry Lawyer. After each stage it checks a result and stops early when that result is nonzero, returning it.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:4F82
name: display_get_ready_screen
description: Draws the get-ready screen with office and character graphics, showing a line for one or two players as appropriate. It then waits until an input bit is set before finishing the screen.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:54FC
name: decode_quinary_state
description: Splits a value into four base-five digits, updates them in a loop according to input flags returned by a routine while redrawing cells, then combines the digits back into one value that it returns.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:5828
name: process_bonus_deduction_screen
description: Draws the wages summary with bonus and deduction lines for each category, looping through a table of entries and updating the shown values. The bundle truncates the routine partway through, so the end of the screen logic and any cheat-mode branches are not recovered.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:6248
name: draw_packing_bonus_deduction_rows
description: Draws bonus, deduction and wages rows for each of five packing categories, but only once a progress counter exceeds twelve. For each category it shows the bonus line when its check passes and the deduction line otherwise, updates the on-screen total, and waits for input between rows.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:6796
name: display_game_over_screen
description: Draws the game over background, then selects player-specific text and graphics depending on a player-count flag, and draws the result labels.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:6ADA
name: draw_marked_entries_until_settled
description: Draws a column of entries from a parameter record, then repeatedly draws the entries whose global value is at or below the loop counter. It keeps looping until no entry matches.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:6C96
name: select_fixit_character
description: Lets the player choose between the Fiona Fixit and Fred Fixit portraits with up and down inputs until a button is pressed. It stores the choice in a global flag, derives a position from a computed value, and returns a packed result.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:71B4
name: show_orders_until_return_key
description: Draws the orders screen and its text asking the player to press F1 to return to the game, then keeps reading input until the return key code arrives.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:7458
name: show_game_over_progress
description: Maps a progress counter onto a display index using fixed steps, and returns the difference from the final step when the counter has not reached it. At the final step it draws the GAME OVER text, calls routines to finish, and returns their result.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:75B8
name: draw_three_entry_rows
description: Draws three entries of a row selected by its arguments, taking each entry's value and label from global tables, and calls the drawing routine once the row is complete. When the second argument is nonzero it also computes a derived value for each entry.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:776C
name: call_helper_with_low_word
description: Passes the low word of its argument to one routine, then calls a second routine with no arguments and returns.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:77A6
name: call_two_helpers_in_order
description: Calls two other routines one after the other and returns. The callees are not identified in this pseudo-code.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:77BA
name: convert_word_to_ascii
description: Writes the tens and units digits of the low word of the argument as two ASCII characters into the buffer, followed by a zero terminator. The layout assumes a value below one hundred.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:77FA
name: poll_global_flag_loop
description: Repeatedly calls a routine with the address of a global variable, and calls a second routine each time bit four of its result is set. It exits when that bit is clear.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:781E
name: check_sprite_buffer_overflow
description: Compares an address offset from a base global against a fixed limit, and when it exceeds the limit calls the error routine that reports that the sprite buffer has overflowed.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:7860
name: clip_and_blit_sprite_rect
description: Waits until the blitter is idle, clips a sprite rectangle against a bounding box, and programs the blitter's masks, modulo registers and control words. It then runs a loop of four blit calls. It returns early when the sprite lies fully outside the clip area.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:7A24
name: wait_and_store_block
description: Waits while bit six of a status byte is set, then stores four long values and one word from the registers into a block of the record.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:7A4A
name: configure_blitter_copy_rect
description: Waits until the blitter is idle, then programs its destination pointer, masks, control word and size from the arguments and a source record. The size write starts the copy.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:7ADC
name: blit_sprite_stripes
description: Waits until the blitter is idle and sets its masks and pointers from a source record. It then blits four stripes of rows, advancing the destination address and row count after each one and switching the control word once the row count runs out.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:7B98
name: forward_parameters_to_routine
description: Passes its two arguments unchanged to another routine and returns. The callee is not identified in this pseudo-code.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:7BC0
name: clip_and_blit_masked_rect
description: Clips a rectangle against a bounding box in the same way as its neighbouring blit routine, then programs the blitter with masks, modulo values and a copy control word. It runs four blit calls and returns.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:7CC0
name: wait_flag_and_store_data
description: Waits while bit six of a status byte in the record is set, then stores a long value into two fields, a word from a pointer into one field, and a word from a register into another.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:7DA8
name: run_blitter_column_passes
description: Waits until the blitter is idle, programs its masks, control word and source and destination pointers from two globals, then starts eight blit passes. Each pass waits for the blitter to be idle before writing the size register.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:7E18
name: setup_blitter_copy
description: Waits until the blitter is idle, then sets its masks, control word, pointers and size from five words of a record. It returns the address just past the source data it has set up.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:7E8C
name: compute_blit_dimensions_setup
description: Computes the width in words, row height and source offset of a block from its position arguments and stores them in a record. It then waits for the blitter, programs its masks, control word and pointers, and returns the address just past the stored data.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:7F2E
name: unrecovered_widely_called_routine
description: Its decompiled body was unavailable, so its behaviour is not recovered. The facts show only that twenty-one other routines call it and that it has fifteen instructions.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:7F7A
name: calculate_string_weight
description: Walks a zero-terminated string and adds up a per-character value. When a global flag is zero it adds the same counter value plus one for each character; otherwise it adds a value from a lookup table indexed by each character code. It returns the total.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:7FDA
name: call_base_then_pass_words
description: Calls one routine with no arguments, then calls a second routine with the low words of its two arguments.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:8018
name: iterate_string_bytes
description: Walks a zero-terminated string and calls a routine once per character, passing a global value, the address of a global variable and the first argument. The callee is not identified in this pseudo-code.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:8082
name: blit_fixed_size_region
description: Waits for the blitter, programs its masks, modulo values and control words from fixed constants, and sets source and destination pointers from a global and the argument. It starts a blit of a fixed size and then calls two routines.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:813E
name: shift_bitplane_data
description: Performs a carry-propagating bit shift over a block of words: four words shift right and the following words shift left, with bits carried between neighbours. It repeats this for three groups spaced twenty words apart.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:8190
name: run_main_game_loop
description: Initializes global variables and buffers, then loops forever. Each pass resets counters, runs a set of checks through repeated calls until one of them reports a condition, clears the flag tables, and repeats.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:8374
name: return_immediately_stub
description: Returns straight away and performs no action. The routine is a one-instruction stub.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:8378
name: clamp_vertical_scroll
description: Moves a global scroll offset toward its argument with hysteresis: it lowers the offset by three when the argument is small, re-anchors it sixteen below the argument when the argument falls under the offset window, and clamps it to a fixed upper bound otherwise.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:83EE
name: build_index_from_records
description: Fills a global table of 802 word entries with record indices for each position, scanning 24-byte records in order and returning early when a record's position exceeds nine hundred ninety-nine.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:8450
name: fetch_table_entry
description: Computes an address in a global table from the upper word of the argument, using eight-byte strides, and passes that address and a routine address to another routine. The callee is not identified in this pseudo-code.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:8476
name: add_decimal_digits_to_string
description: Adds seven packed decimal digits from a source buffer into the digit string at a fixed global address, working from the last digit with carry, and writes each result as an ASCII digit.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:847E
name: add_decimal_digits_from_index
description: Adds seven packed decimal digits from a source buffer into the digit string at a position chosen from a global index, working from the last digit with carry, and writes each result as an ASCII digit.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:84C8
name: handle_pause_and_restart_prompt
description: Handles pause-screen key codes. One code shows a pause message and returns zero, another toggles a flag, and the pause key code returns one. A restart code shows a yes-or-no prompt, returning minus one when the player answers yes and zero on no.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:862A
name: process_fixit_entities
description: Loops over two table entries repeatedly, calling routines for each active entry, and clears an entry once the step counter has reached its final step while the entry is still active. It repeats until two loop flags clear. The file name F.FIXIT is referenced here.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:87D2
name: run_gameplay_update_loop
description: Runs one main gameplay update pass, drawing and updating entries through many routine calls, and returns a status code when a limit or end condition is reached. The demo file name is referenced in its text.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:8FC0
name: initialize_game_state
description: Sets seven global flags to one, clears several progress globals, sets an active-state global, calls setup routines, and returns the result of one of those calls.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:905E
name: initialize_global_state
description: Sets a global byte to zero, then to sixteen and then to six, stores the twelve-bit all-ones value into a table entry chosen by a global offset, and calls routines with the packed global bytes before finishing.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:90D8
name: update_row_state_counter
description: Advances a per-row state word by a fixed step and totals the seven bytes of the current row. When the total is zero it resets the word to a sentinel; otherwise it updates a direction-like byte from input flags, wrapping it within seven steps.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:9104
name: update_row_state_fragment
description: A fragment entry into the same row-state update as its neighbour. It advances the row state word, totals the row's bytes, and updates the direction byte from flags in the caller's record.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:9196
name: update_row_state_tail
description: A fragment of the row-state update that handles the flag-driven direction change and the wraparound search, then records the caller's flag word. It shares its logic with the neighbouring routine.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:91E4
name: set_direction_from_flags
description: Sets a direction byte from two flag bits in the caller's record, wraps it within seven steps, and searches forward through the row for a nonzero cell. It then records the caller's flag word.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:91F6
name: set_direction_from_bit_three
description: Sets a direction byte from bit three of the caller's flag byte, wraps it within seven steps, and searches forward through the row for a nonzero cell. It then records the caller's flag word.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:9208
name: step_direction_backward
description: Steps a direction byte back by one with wraparound within seven positions, searches the row for a nonzero cell, and records the caller's flag word.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:923E
name: search_row_for_nonzero_cell
description: Steps a direction byte alternately down and up through a row of seven cells until it finds a nonzero cell, then records the caller's flag word and returns.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:9294
name: find_nearest_nonzero_cell
description: Searches a row of seven cells outward from the current position in both directions for a nonzero cell. It stores the nearest forward and backward positions in globals, or minus one when no cell is found.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:9340
name: increment_table_entry
description: Increments a cell in the current row of a table, chosen by the argument minus one, sets a global to six, and calls another routine.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:9372
name: decrement_cell_unless_last
description: If the global index plus one is not seven, decrements the cell in the current row at that index, sets a global to six, and calls another routine. It returns the index plus one in every case.
